nodes.label: Component protocol
nodes.desc: Protocol every component satisfies: a run() whose signature is the machine-readable contract

nodes.label: ComponentMeta
nodes.desc: Metaclass that parses run() parameters and return hints into sockets at instantiation

nodes.label: component decorator
nodes.desc: Decorator singleton wrapping component classes; gateway to socket-level tweaks

nodes.label: set_input_type
nodes.desc: Re-declares one input socket type after the fact, for dynamic or widened inputs

nodes.label: InputSocket
nodes.desc: Typed receiver with optional default and a sender list that can grow variadic

nodes.label: OutputSocket
nodes.desc: Typed producer whose declared type is matched against downstream receivers

nodes.label: graph owner base
nodes.desc: Graph owner: components registry, networkx MultiDiGraph, wiring and validation logic

nodes.label: add_component
nodes.desc: Validates the instance and inserts it as a named node

nodes.label: connect
nodes.desc: Resolves name.socket strings, checks type compatibility, records the edge or raises

nodes.label: parse_connect_string
nodes.desc: Splits sender.receiver notation, including dotted socket names

nodes.label: _types_are_compatible
nodes.desc: Typing compatibility check; returns an optional conversion strategy for mismatches

nodes.label: _make_socket_auto_variadic
nodes.desc: Converts a receiver to variadic when several senders target it, collecting lists

nodes.label: networkx.MultiDiGraph
nodes.desc: The stored graph; edges keyed by sender/receiver socket names

nodes.label: dumps / loads
nodes.desc: YAML round-trip via YamlMarshaller for sharing and rebuilding the graph

nodes.label: run
nodes.desc: Synchronous scheduler: validate inputs, seed the queue, pop, run, write outputs

nodes.label: validate_input
nodes.desc: Rejects unknown or missing top-level inputs before execution starts

nodes.label: _calculate_priority
nodes.desc: Ranks queued components from READY down to BLOCKED using ComponentPriority

nodes.label: _topological_sort
nodes.desc: Lexicographic topological sort; condensation groups cycles so loops can iterate

nodes.label: FIFOPriorityQueue
nodes.desc: Deterministic work queue feeding the run loop

nodes.label: _get_next_runnable_component
nodes.desc: Picks the next runnable entry and guards against stale queue states

nodes.label: _run_component
nodes.desc: One execution: breakpoint check, span, run(), Mapping output check, visit count

nodes.label: _write_component_outputs
nodes.desc: Routes outputs to receiver sockets, applying conversion strategies

nodes.label: run_async
nodes.desc: Async path: runs independent components concurrently as asyncio tasks

nodes.label: run_async_generator
nodes.desc: Streaming async variant yielding partial results as components finish

nodes.label: breakpoint snapshots
nodes.desc: BreakpointException stops a run and persists a snapshot for later resume

nodes.label: Agent
nodes.desc: Component that hides a full tool-calling loop behind a single run() socket set

nodes.label: Agent.run
nodes.desc: Loops chat generator calls plus tool executions until an exit condition; returns messages and usage stats

nodes.label: _run_step
nodes.desc: One step: one LLM call plus every tool call the model requested in it

nodes.label: Tool.invoke
nodes.desc: Calls the wrapped function after checking arguments against the tool schema

nodes.label: AgentTool
nodes.desc: Exposes a whole Agent as a Tool so agents can compose other agents

nodes.label: OpenAIChatGenerator.run
nodes.desc: Chat Completions call with streaming callback support

nodes.label: SuperComponent
nodes.desc: Wraps an inner graph behind a normal component interface with explicit input/output mappings

nodes.label: sub-graph flattening
nodes.desc: Flattens wrapped sub-graphs into one graph before execution

nodes.label: ProxyTracer
nodes.desc: Global tracer swap: null spans by default, real spans once tracing is enabled
